overview: White fianchettoes with g3 but plays a3 and then Nf3-h4 against Black's ...e5, ...d5, ...e4 centre. After 5.d3 White attacks the e4 pawn and may allow Bxh4 gxh4 to double pawns for a bishop pair. A rarely seen line read mostly from the moves, with no clear gambit that stays given.

white_ideas.idea: Challenge e4 with d3 and Bg2, opening the long diagonal
Accept doubled h-pawns for the bishop pair if Black takes on h4

black_ideas.idea: Keep the e4/d5 chain and support it with ...f5
Trade on h4 or defend e4 and attack with ...Bxh4 if worthwhile

typical_structures.structure: Black pawns on d5 and e4 against White d3, long diagonal tension

character.notes: Slow flank play with tension against e4, little forcing.

gambit.notes: The name says gambit but I cannot see a pawn given by force after d3 exd3.

level.notes: Few theory, plans are not hard.

character.reason: Slow tension around e4; unsure of the exact lines.

gambit.reason: No clear pawn given up that Black keeps by force.

plans.reason: White's bishop on g2 targets the e4 pawn.
